heading: Optimise NPS for Higher Returns & a Bigger Retirement Corpus
tldr: The National Pension System (NPS) offers a low-cost, market-linked avenue for retirement planning.
Optimising your asset allocation, especially increasing equity exposure early, can significantly boost your corpus.
Regular voluntary contributions beyond mandatory deductions enhance your savings and provide additional tax benefits.
Periodically reviewing and rebalancing your portfolio ensures it aligns with your risk profile and financial goals.
Choosing a well-performing Pension Fund Manager (PFM) and understanding their charges is crucial for long-term growth.
caption:
Want a bigger nest egg for your retirement? The National Pension System (NPS) can help you get there. Think of it like a special savings plan for your future. By making smart choices, especially early on, you can make your money grow much faster. This means more money for you when you stop working! Learn how to make your NPS work harder for you. Read our full article to find out more.
